page.overview:
What is NCC-1701?

NCC-1701 was the designation of a starship of an unusual shape that was present on Coruscant when Wilhuff Tarkin, Bevel Lemelisk and Tol Sivron went to seek approval for the Death Star I project from Emperor Palpatine.
